title: Global Well-posedness for the Multi-species Boltzmann Equation with Large Amplitude Initial Data
summary: This paper establishes the global well-posedness of the multi-species Boltzmann equation with large-amplitude initial data in the periodic domain $\mathbb{T}^3$. In contrast to the single-species case, the multi-species mixture model lacks structural symmetry in its collision operators due to the distinct masses of different species. This asymmetry makes it difficult to obtain pointwise estimates for the nonlinear collision terms.
